text:
Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only, so a plant ordered on Thursday ships the following Monday. If you ordered this past Thursday (Oct 1), that would be tomorrow, Monday, Oct 5. Tracking is emailed when it ships and can take up to 24 hours to update.

Delivery after shipping depends on your zone. Standard takes 2-3 business days in Zone 1, 3-5 in Zone 2 and 5-8 in Zone 3. Express is next business day in Zone 1 and 2 business days in Zone 2, and isn't available in Zone 3. If the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, your plant may be held up to 7 days, and we'd email you if that happens.
